description: Push tickets and stream tokens the framework's Go and Java code issued at commit 2360d29, before the token-spelling contract (docs/contracts/token-spelling.md, section 6). A FIXTURE, written once and never regenerated: every implementation must still accept each value. Go and Java issued byte-identical values (EdDSA and HMAC are deterministic and both write the claims in the same order). The code of 2360d29 was run again in a throwaway worktree on 2026-11-19: the Go code reproduced all four values byte for byte, and the Java verifiers of 2360d29 accept them. The keys are the TEST KEYS of tickets.json (current test-2026-a, previous test-2025-z) and streamSecret is push.stream.secret (a TEST SECRET): never configure them anywhere real.
howToRun: Tickets: build the ticket keys from tickets.json 'keys' (current, previous) and check each ticket for application 'fulfil' at 'now' with maxLifetimeSeconds 3600 and no proof key: each is valid, for 'client' and 'principal' ('' when it names none). Stream tokens: verify each with streamSecret at 'now': valid, with the claims given.
